facts.text: Big purchases like this are usually paid on no-cost EMI rather than in one go.
Most sim racers here started on a gear or belt wheel and upgrade parts one at a time.
Imported direct-drive bases are bought through a few Indian resellers, with import duty in the price.

reviews.about: an imported direct-drive kit from a reseller
reviews.text: Great force feedback, but the base took six weeks to arrive and the reseller stopped replying after delivery.
Rig flexes under hard braking and they never sent the replacement bracket they promised.
Tried a full direct-drive rig for an hour before buying my own. Best money I spent.
